Marlene, it is our last day. Do you want to go to Siena or stay in Florence?
Siena, please. People say it is smaller and more peaceful than Florence. How long does it take?
It takes about one hour and a half by train. The train leaves at nine, but sometimes it is delayed.
No problem. Which platform does it leave from?
Platform six. And in Siena there is a market. I want some cheese for a picnic.

Good morning, Marlene, it is Giulia. I know today is your last day in Italy, and I am sad. Here is some information for tomorrow. Checkout is at eleven o'clock, but you can leave your suitcase at the reception. Your train to Rome airport leaves at two fifteen from platform nine. It takes about two hours, so you have a lot of time. If the train is delayed, call me and I can help you. Tonight, the hotel has a small goodbye dinner on the terrace. The chef knows about Paul's nut allergy, so do not worry. It was a pleasure to have you here. See you tonight.

Good morning, everybody, and welcome to our last tour of the week. Today we visit Siena. The train from Florence takes one hour and a half, and it arrives at ten thirty. Siena is smaller and quieter than Florence, and many people think it is more beautiful. At twelve we stop at a small market in the main square. There are stalls with fresh cheese, bread and handmade souvenirs. You can buy a piece of cheese for your picnic. Lunch is at a family restaurant. If you are allergic to something, tell me now, please. We take the train back to Florence at five o'clock.

First, you look at the timetable and you find the platform for the train to Siena. Then you arrive in Siena, and it is more peaceful than Florence. Next, you buy a bottle of olive oil as a souvenir at the market. After that, at lunch, you ask the waiter if the pesto has nuts in it. Finally, you take the train back to Florence and you write your travel blog.
